req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /health/ returns HTTP 2xx with sub-second latency and no external dependencies. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET returns exactly 200; (2) negative NEG — wrong method POST returns 4xx (405); (3) boundary BVA — latency must be strictly < 1000 ms (testing the sub-second threshold); (4) DT — response body content is well-formed and non-empty; (5) STC — repeated calls remain stable (idempotent probe). Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.executable:
import time
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_latency_sub_second():
    client = TestClient(app)
    start = time.monotonic()
    response = client.get('/health/')
    elapsed_ms = (time.monotonic() - start) * 1000
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert elapsed_ms < 1000, f'Latency {elapsed_ms:.1f}ms exceeded 1000ms threshold'

test_health_latency_sub_second()
